payload.summary: Residual from the trvskz62 fix (worker-flagged, deliberately not touched): validate/checks.ts mutes the never-merge checks whenever scanPrototypeRefs returns scan.error, so at the CLI level an output-cap overflow now reports NOTHING for those checks rather than a false all-clear — safer than before but still silent. Closing it needs a new check id (e.g. prototype.unscannable) surfacing the aborted scan as a finding, plus the matching line in nahel/workflows/prototype-lane.md. Small follow-up chore candidate.
